author: Inside Edition
description: There was fury on the streets of Minneapolis Wednesday night. Federal agents say they were "conducting a targeted traffic stop" of a Venezuelan migrant. Agents say the migrant and two others "ambushed" an officer, "striking him with a shovel or broom stick." Authorities say "the officer fired a defensive shot to defend his life," hitting the migrant in the leg. On Thursday, President Donald Trump threatened to invoke the Insurrection Act.
title: Fury In Minneapolis After ICE Agent Shoots Man In Leg

author: Inside Edition
description: Jennifer Lawrence is coming under fire for rehoming her chihuahua after the dog bit her 3-year-old son. The dog, named Princess Pippi Longstocking, went everywhere with Lawrence, but things changed after the little dog bit her son Cy. Fans pounced on her decision to rehome. She is also getting lots of support. Lawrence gave her dog to her parents. What should a parent do if your family dog suddenly attacks a child? Inside Edition spoke to veterinarian Dr. Timnah Lee.
title: Jennifer Lawrence Under Fire For Rehoming Dog After Her Son Got Bit

author: Inside Edition
description: Donkey's Place, a bar in Camden, New Jersey, wants help finding an unusual but beloved artifact.
title: New Jersey Bar Wants Stolen Walrus Penis Back #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: "Star Search" is back. The popular 80s talent competition has been reimagined for a new generation. Taking the place of the original host Ed McMahon is comedian Anthony Anderson. There is a panel of celebrity judges including rapper Jelly Roll, actress Sarah Michelle Gellar and model Chrissy Teigen. The original "Star Search" started in 1983 and ran for 12 years. Some of the biggest names today were once contestants and lost, like Beyonce, Christina Aguilera and Britney Spears.
title: 'Star Search' Is Coming Back

author: Inside Edition
description: Amy Fisher, dubbed The Long Island Lolita, was 17 years old when she shot the wife of her 36-year-old boyfriend, Joey Buttafuoco in the face. Mary Jo Buttafuoco survived and Fisher was sentenced to five to 15 years in prison. Joey was sentenced for statutory rape. Inside Edition was there for every twist and turn in the saga. Now, Mary Jo's story is being retold from her point of view in a new Lifetime movie "I Am Mary Jo Buttafuoco."
title: New Lifetime Movie Shares Story Of Mary Jo Buttafuoco

author: Inside Edition
description: A monkey is now captured after breaking into a Morristown, Tennessee, pawn shop and causing complete chaos. It happened when the owners came in to feed their cats while the store was closed. They walked into a mess and saw that a monkey was on the loose. The monkey was cute, but destructive, and caused a lot of damage. Trade Center owner Loretta Bryant shared the hilarious story with Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall.
title: Monkey Causes Havoc After Breaking Into Tennessee Pawn Store

author: Inside Edition
description: A sheriff's deputy seemed to have a little too much fun making a recent arrest. The St. Johns County Sheriff's Office posted a bodycam video of the unusual incident to social media. It started with an unusual call about an emu on the loose. Corporal Keisler was able to track it down, but after tailing the bird, and cornering it in a wooded area, he wasn't sure how to handle the situation. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Deputy Handcuffs Emu After It Escaped From Home
